necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias. To accurately capture the frequency and duration of these episodic symptoms for appropriate management, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered. This service corresponds to CPT 93229 and addresses diagnoses I49.9 and I48.91.
